verdict.rationale: DPMA is a patent and trade mark office with online search databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing services. Offices of this kind can plausibly publish developer APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only web search portals, e-filing routes, downloadable filing software and a robots.txt probe, with no interactive API reference or runnable examples, so the verdict is none rather than na.
